name: Tiles
description: Sliding number tiles in a panel, to play while Claude works. Slide with the arrows, WASD or a swipe, merge equal tiles and reach the gold tile; three boards (4×4, 5×5, 6×6), one step of undo and your best score per board. When a Claude tab of the window finishes and waits for you, the game pauses and names that tab, with a button to go to it. Reads only the window's tab statuses; never types into a session, runs nothing and uses no network.
author: BronOS
